Opens secondlife:// links now: [EXE] This viewer: [OURS]
Links on web pages (such as "Visit this location" on maps.secondlife.com) open the program registered for secondlife://. The browser first asks whether to open it ("Open Charis Viewer?"); you can tick "always allow" there. Pages at https://maps.secondlife.com themselves stay in the browser.

secondlife:// links from the browser open in [NAME] now.
Open them with this viewer instead? Only your Windows user's settings change (no administrator rights). "Undo" puts [NAME] back.

x-grid-location-info:// links (links to other grids) from the browser open in [NAME] now.
Open them, and secondlife:// links, with this viewer? Only your Windows user's settings change (no administrator rights). "Undo" puts [NAME] back.
x-grid-location-info:// links (links to other grids) open in [NAME] now; they will open in this viewer too.
secondlife:// links from the browser now open in this viewer. "Undo" puts back what opened them before.
Registered, but Windows' default apps names another app for secondlife:// links, and that choice comes first. Change it in Windows Settings > Apps > Default apps (search for "secondlife").
This viewer's path cannot be registered safely (it has a % sign or another special character). Nothing was changed. Put the viewer in another folder and try again.
The registration could not be written. What was there before was put back.
The registration could not be written, and some of it could not be put back: the links may now open this viewer, another Charis Viewer or nothing. Press "Open them with this viewer" again later.
What opened secondlife:// links before this viewer is back.
secondlife:// links are not registered to this viewer (another viewer registered them since); nothing was changed.
Some of the registration could not be put back. Press "Undo" again later, or reinstall the viewer that should open the links.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: plus_slurl_register
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Open them with this viewer
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Makes secondlife:// links clicked in the browser open this viewer (for your Windows user only, no administrator rights). What opened them before is kept for Undo. Nothing is registered unless you press this.

plus_ps_button_compat.name: plus_slurl_undo
plus_ps_button_compat.label: Undo
plus_ps_button_compat.tool_tip: Puts back the viewer that opened secondlife:// links before you pressed "Open them with this viewer". Do this before you delete this viewer's folder.

plus_ps_check_compat.name: plus_slurl_check_at_start
plus_ps_check_compat.label: At start, tell me when another viewer opens these links
plus_ps_check_compat.tool_tip: Off by default. When on, the viewer looks once at start and tells you when secondlife:// links open another viewer. It only tells; it never registers by itself.
